```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 3)

options(bitmapType = 'cairo')
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(Cairo)

theme_set(theme_minimal() +
          theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
                axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
                axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")))
```

## Data Loading

```{r}
repos_detailed_df <- read_csv("../data/repos_with_details.csv")

metrics_df <- repos_detailed_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(agent_adopt_month)) %>%
    mutate(adoption_yearmonth = agent_adopt_month) %>%
    filter(adoption_yearmonth >= "2024-05", adoption_yearmonth < "2025-08")
```

## Distribution of Agent Adoption Time

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=4, out.width="100%"}
agent_first <- read_lines("../data/agent_first.txt") %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    .[. != ""]

ide_first <- read_lines("../data/ide_first.txt") %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    .[. != ""]

metrics_agent <- metrics_df %>%
    filter(name %in% agent_first)

metrics_ide <- metrics_df %>%
    filter(name %in% ide_first)

adoption_counts_agent <- metrics_agent %>%
    count(adoption_yearmonth) %>%
    arrange(adoption_yearmonth)

adoption_counts_ide <- metrics_ide %>%
    count(adoption_yearmonth) %>%
    arrange(adoption_yearmonth)

adoption_combined <- bind_rows(
    adoption_counts_agent %>% mutate(category = "Repositories without prior AI traces (AF)"),
    adoption_counts_ide %>% mutate(category = "Repositories with prior AI traces (IF)")
) %>%
    complete(adoption_yearmonth, category, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
    mutate(category = factor(category, levels = c("Repositories without prior AI traces (AF)", 
                                                   "Repositories with prior AI traces (IF)")))

p_combined <- ggplot(adoption_combined, aes(x = adoption_yearmonth, y = n, fill = category)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n, color = category), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.3, size = 2.5) +
    labs(x = "Year-Month", y = "Number of Repositories", fill = "") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Repositories without prior AI traces (AF)" = "#0072B2", 
                                  "Repositories with prior AI traces (IF)" = "#D55E00"),
                      breaks = c("Repositories without prior AI traces (AF)", "Repositories with prior AI traces (IF)")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Repositories without prior AI traces (AF)" = "#0072B2", 
                                   "Repositories with prior AI traces (IF)" = "#D55E00"),
                       guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 200), clip = "off") +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 35, r = 5, b = 40, l = 5, unit = "pt"))

print(p_combined)
ggsave("../plots/agent_adoption_time_combined.pdf", plot = p_combined, width = 7, height = 3.5, device = CairoPDF, family = "DejaVu Sans")
```
